User-defined and subgroup interventions

intervention.Rd

Write your own intervention rule, or restrict an intervention to a subgroup.

Usage

intervention(rule, label = "custom rule")

subgroup(g, condition)

Arguments

rule

A function function(s, a) or a transition matrix (see Details).

label

Label used in printed output.

g

An intervention (setto(), shift(), natural() or intervention()).

condition

A logical expression evaluated in the analysis data.

Value

An object of class lcc_intervention.

Details

  • intervention(rule): a rule for the intervened exposures. rule is either a function function(s, a) returning the probability that a person whose natural (observed) values of the intervened exposures are a gets the values s (both 0/1 vectors in the order of intervene), or the corresponding transition matrix with one row per natural pattern a and one column per new pattern s, in binary order with the first exposure varying slowest (two exposures: 00, 01, 10, 11). For every a the probabilities over s must sum to 1.

  • subgroup(g, condition): apply intervention g only to the rows where condition (evaluated in the data, e.g. female == 1 or income < 20000) is TRUE; everyone else keeps their natural exposures. Rows where condition is NA are not intervened on. Only for intervene_effect() (data-frame interface).

See also

natural(), setto(), shift(), intervene_effect()

Examples

# remove the first intervened exposure only; the second keeps its natural value
intervention(function(s, a) as.numeric(all(s == c(0, a[2]))), label = "remove ace1 only")
#> <intervention> remove ace1 only
# the same rule as a transition matrix (patterns 00, 01, 10, 11)
intervention(rbind(c(1, 0, 0, 0), c(0, 1, 0, 0), c(1, 0, 0, 0), c(0, 1, 0, 0)))
#> <intervention> custom rule
# a 20 percent chance of preventing each exposure, for women only
subgroup(shift(0.2), female == 1)
#> <intervention> shift 1→0 with probability 0.2 if female == 1
data(ace_study)
# \donttest{
# Would preventing abuse (ace1) alone, leaving neglect (ace2) as it is, improve adult
# self-rated health (health, 0-100)?
abuse_only <- intervention(function(s, a) as.numeric(all(s == c(0, a[2]))),
                           label = "prevent abuse only")
intervene_effect(ace_study, outcome = health, exposures = ace1:ace8,
                    intervene = c(ace1, ace2), confounders = c(age, female, parent_edu),
                    g1 = abuse_only)
#> Starting Julia ...
#> ▸ Effect of a hypothetical intervention on exposures
#>   AIPW, 5-fold cross-fitting, gaussian outcome; N = 2500
#>   Outcome:      health
#>   Intervene:    ace1, ace2
#>   Adjusted for: ace3, ace4, ace5, ace6, ace7, ace8, age, female, parent_edu
#>   g1:           prevent abuse only
#>   g0:           natural course
#> 
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>                        Estimate     SE            95% CI      p
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>   E[Yᵍ¹]                 78.063  0.273  [77.529, 78.598]       
#>   E[Yᵍ⁰]                 76.701  0.255  [76.202, 77.201]       
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>   ψ = E[Yᵍ¹] − E[Yᵍ⁰]     1.362  0.144    [1.080, 1.645]  <.001
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#>   Overlap: min P(A_S = s | H) = 0.0054, max weight = 7.5
#>   ⚠ near-violation of positivity: some post-intervention profiles are rare
# psi ~ +1.39 points (true +1.29): about 60\% of preventing both (~ +2.26)

# Prevent abuse and neglect only among children whose parents had at most 10 years of
# education (28 percent of the sample)
intervene_effect(ace_study, outcome = health, exposures = ace1:ace8,
                    intervene = c(ace1, ace2), confounders = c(age, female, parent_edu),
                    g1 = subgroup(setto(c(0, 0)), parent_edu <= 10))
#> ▸ Effect of a hypothetical intervention on exposures
#>   AIPW, 5-fold cross-fitting, gaussian outcome; N = 2500
#>   Outcome:      health
#>   Intervene:    ace1, ace2
#>   Adjusted for: ace3, ace4, ace5, ace6, ace7, ace8, age, female, parent_edu
#>   g1:           set to (0, 0) if parent_edu <= 10
#>   g0:           natural course
#> 
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>                        Estimate     SE            95% CI      p
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>   E[Yᵍ¹]                 77.545  0.278  [77.001, 78.089]       
#>   E[Yᵍ⁰]                 76.701  0.255  [76.202, 77.201]       
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#>   ψ = E[Yᵍ¹] − E[Yᵍ⁰]     0.843  0.133    [0.582, 1.105]  <.001
#>   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#>   Overlap: min P(A_S = s | H) = 0.0054, max weight = 8.5
#>   ⚠ near-violation of positivity: some post-intervention profiles are rare
# psi (~ +0.86; true +0.81) is the population-average gain from this targeted prevention
# }
